content_fields.title: Audit the Docker daemon and its files (Docker)
content_fields.description: Audit the Docker daemon and its supporting files.
content_fields.guidance: Host audit rules should record access to and modification of the daemon binary, socket, configuration and container storage directories, with the resulting records shipped to central log storage.
content_fields.found: No audit configuration exists in the repository.
content_fields.missing: Host audit daemon rules and a log destination.
content_fields.conclusion: Auditing the container runtime is host instrumentation applied outside this repository.
content_fields.action: The platform team should add audit rules for the daemon and its files.
